quote: NORWALK, CT – August 22, 2024 –GameChange Solar… today announced a new order for a 148 MW solar project in Colombia… The project will feature 101 MW of the Genius Tracker™ 1P system and 47 MW of the MaxSpan™ fixed-tilt system… "We are proud to have local support in Colombia and are excited to be selected for our seventh project in the country," said Vikas Bansal
note: Opened GameChange Solar English release 22 Aug 2024 (148 MW Colombia).
